cells.note: eef_abs_rotvec: 7-d [xyz, rotvec(q_cmd * q_ref^-1), gripper], q_ref = nominal top-down grasp; matches the EEF residual cell's width and rotation format
joint_chunk_absgrip: arm actions of a 16-step chunk relative to the joints measured at the query (not each step); gripper absolute
eef_chunk: eef_delta's 7 columns relative to the grasp-point pose measured at the query (not each step)
